name: u11-facing-puncher
description: ⛓⛓⛓ U11-swim D2 — THE FACING DURING A KNOCKBACK'S I-FRAME, U10's control extended past the punch. L12 at (400,248), inside `puncher@416,256`'s leash, with a sword and `noDamage` FALSE; the kill arm's preview keys at this boot (a one-tick lean east, then a press, at t 1-2 and t 34-35), 50 ticks. The punch at t 34 parks the facing EAST; the press on t 35 swings EAST and lands (the puncher reads `hits` 2 from t 36). The punch's knockback is absorbed by the wall west of the player, so the PLAYER stream is the same under either facing: the observable is the puncher's `hits`, read by `probe-seedling-u9-shield-mobiles.mjs --class=Puncher`. Authored by scripts/procgen/plan-seedling-u11-facing.mjs.
